title: A recent document card offers the mock's Copy, Pin and Delete
goal: Under the front door's Recent, the mock gives every card Copy, Edit, Pin and Delete when you point at it. A document you saved shows Edit, Show in Finder and Remove from Recent instead, because nothing in the app can pin yet and Delete on a document would throw away your own file from a launcher. Decide with the user what a document card should offer, then build it.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/ui-entry-wt.html ~300-330 (.filmcard .acts: Copy, Edit, Pin, Delete). Built: Sources/Photonz/FrontDoorView.swift FrontDoorRecentCard.actions (document case: Edit, Show in Finder, Remove from Recent; capture case keeps the history strip's Copy, Edit, Show in Finder, Delete; no Pin anywhere in the app). Copy for a .photonz could copy its preview (PackageIO.readPreview). From the-front-door-s-recent-lists-documents-you-open. | 2026-10-15 runner: Copy built for document cards (FrontDoorCopy: .photonz rendered whole off main via PackageIO.read + DocumentRenderer, picture file via CaptureStore.copyToPasteboard, recording via ClipboardWriter.writeFile); row and menu read FrontDoor.actions. Walk front-door-recent-card-actions-walk (startFromFrontDoor rest/first/gone) proves Copy, Edit, Remove from Recent by pointer at Next defaults. Show in Finder is deliberately not clicked by the walk: it activates Finder over the person. Remaining: Pin (not in the app at all) and what the last button does, on the decision card.
acceptance: A decision card asks the user whether a document card's Delete removes the file or only the card, and whether Pin is wanted
The document card's hover row and right-click menu offer what the user picked
A walk points at a document card and clicks each action by pointer, green at Next defaults

log.note: left rough (digest 2026-10-10): the front door draws its own blue button (FrontDoorProminentButtonStyle in FrontDoorView.swift, stays blue behind another app) while the editor's confirm buttons use the shared .activeProminent style (DesignSystem/ActiveProminentButtonStyle.swift, grey bordered behind). Two answers to the same problem built on the same day. Not filed: nobody reads it as wrong, but whoever next touches the front door's buttons should move them onto the shared style.

Adversarial pass: a Photoshop/Finder hand expects recent lists to remove, not delete, so Delete on a document stays a user call. Copy on a project must not paste a 480px preview or the .photonz package into Slack, so it renders the project full size (verified 1440x960 PNG on the clipboard). Built Copy (commit 6fd15036), walk green with 2 real window pictures; opened both: the hover row shows Copy/Edit/Finder/X and the card is gone after Remove from Recent with the file still on disk. Decision card filed for Pin + Delete, recommended b. No audit yet: the feature is not done until the card is answered; picture for the card at queue/audits/2026-10-15-recent-document-card-row.png.
Copy built and walked for document cards (6fd15036). Pin and what the last button does wait on the decision card: keep Remove from Recent, add Pin, or delete the file as the mock draws.

decision "A saved document's card under Recent: should it offer Pin, and should Delete throw the file away?" resolved: Copy, Edit, Pin, Remove from Recent (Taken as recommended: the user, 2026-10-19, said there were too many cards, most did not matter and they could not follow them. Change it later only if they complain about the result)
